sections.advice: Use Hannover north gate → Bergen food stop as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
sections.photoQuery: Hannover north gate Celle fuel gate Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Bergen food stop → Müden Örtze photo stop is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.
sections.photoQuery: Bergen food stop Burgdorf return road Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Treat Müden Örtze photo stop → Hermannsburg heath road as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
sections.photoQuery: Müden Örtze photo stop Bergen food stop Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Hermannsburg heath road → Celle fuel gate is the reward section in Hannover. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
sections.photoQuery: Hermannsburg heath road Müden Örtze photo stop Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: The forest part from Celle fuel gate to Hermannsburg heath road rewards quiet precision. The road may look empty, but surface changes and animals do not care about your schedule.
sections.photoQuery: Celle fuel gate Hermannsburg heath road Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 35 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-chateau-de-sasso-corbaro-vi-1-emi.story: 378 km from Bellinzona to Bellinzona, about 6 h 31 of riding. It goes by way of Sacri Monti of Piedmont and Lombardy, Sacro Monte del Rosario di Varese, Sacro Monte di San Francesco d’Orta San Gi and VI.1-Emissario. The highest point is about 1,500 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
